comment: The versioned truth for the test-benchmark lane (docs/CI-SCENARIOS.md). Disks are FIXED-size VHDX files created by .github/scripts/New-TestDisk.ps1 (diskpart-only: no Hyper-V module dependency, deterministic on every runner image). Scenarios are applied by bench/scenarios/apply-scenario.ps1; ground truth is ALWAYS the seed manifest + the deletion method - never a tool's own output (extra finds are recorded, never failures). Gate floors are derived from the recorded baseline-candidate measurements (bench/baseline-candidate.json, run 40073093997-smoke; PERFORMANCE-PROFILE.md) with headroom for corpus/runner variance; known engine gaps (bench/root-causes.json) are gated observe-only and say so - a gate must never test a documented gap as if it were a promise.

gate.note: NTFS permanent-delete measured 87.16% recall (baseline-candidate, deepcarve); floor 0.80 = regression headroom. Gate metric: deleted (keep=false) size>0 files recovered with SHA-256 match.

FAT32 deleted-entry recovery is a KNOWN ENGINE GAP (GAP-S6-1/S6-2, measured 0-0.3% recall; root-causes.json) - recorded ungated. Hash-only matches (LFN-lost 8.3-name class) still count toward the recorded number.
recycle-bin $I/$R pairing measured 26/26 name recall (BENCHMARK-REPORT.md, run 39924932944). $R payload content is byte-identical to the original - hash gate applies.

after Clear-RecycleBin the $I/$R metadata is itself deleted; payload recovery is verified by content hash (inventory hash-only match level). Original-name restoration is recorded but not gated (deleted-$I pairing is best-effort).
quick-format recall is a KNOWN ENGINE GAP (GAP-S6-4: name-only remnant scan, 0% vs og 51.5%) - recorded ungated. The scenario still exercises the full format-recovery path end to end.

GATE = the lost partition is DISCOVERED (scan --json lost_partitions >= 1) AND recover completes with exit 0/2. File recall is discovery-limited (43.0% measured) and recorded ungated. Post-actions: the lost-partition APPLY feature probe (dry-run + real apply + partition-reappears assertion).

the first 8 sectors of every deleted file's first extent are 0xAA-overwritten - those files CANNOT hash-match by construction; the recorded recall covers the non-overwritten remainder. Recorded ungated (honesty about physics, not a gap).
MFT records zeroed + $Bitmap XORed - structured NTFS recovery is destroyed by construction; the carve-only salvage path is what this scenario exercises. Recorded ungated.

cancel_resume_probe.note: the pause/cancel/session feature probe: cancel a live scan mid-flight, save the partial session, resume it to completion (the CLI's exit-3 + --resume contract via the API). Tree parity across resume is NOT gated (the known carve-dedup resume gap, bench/root-causes.json behavior_probes) - recorded.
